name: EZ Promotion & Apparel, LLC
old_description: Call us to speak with our team. We take the time to get to know you and what your promo needs are.
about:
EZ Promotion & Apparel, LLC operates from Watertown, Wisconsin. The company is organized as a limited liability company; no founding year, founder names, or specific ownership designations such as veteran- or woman-owned are disclosed in the available sources.

The firm acts as a promotional-products distributor and branding partner. It sources apparel, accessories, drinkware, and other merchandise, then applies custom decoration and manages the entire fulfillment chain. Core services include building and hosting branded online swag shops with Shopify integration, handling inventory-free order processing, and shipping worldwide. The company advertises a 2–3 day turnaround on swag-shop orders and emphasizes a no-upfront-cost model for its storefront clients.

Clients span education, healthcare, and general corporate sectors. Concrete examples include an elementary-school fundraiser needing T-shirts and incentive prizes, a medical practice ordering custom scrub tops, and businesses running trade-show giveaways, direct-mail campaigns, and sponsorship activations. The company also supports remote-employee engagement programs and customer-appreciation gift boxes.

The stated differentiator is an "EZ guarantee" that promises to return clients' time by delivering customized product recommendations after a brief discovery process. Speed, a hands-off inventory model, and integrated e-commerce setup are presented as the primary value drivers.
built_on: Simple Shopify integration for online stores
No upfront costs for swag-shop setup
type_evidence: Buying promotional products in bulk unlocks great rates... We handle everything – from designing merchandise to setting up your swag store, managing orders and shipping to your supports.
